http_enable_stream_copy.description: Enable streamed copies (data passes via the client)

http_default_copy_mode.description: Default mode for HTTP copy; allowed values: '3rd pull', '3rd push', 'streamed'

http_insecure.description: Enable or disable the SSL CA check

http_metalink.description: Enable or disable Davix Metalink support

http_log_level.description: Force Davix log level (0–5); 0 inherits Gfal2 verbosity, 4–5 for detailed debugging

http_log_sensitive.description: Enable Davix logging of sensitive information

http_log_content.description: Enable Davix logging of HTTP request/response body (debugging only)

s3_secret_key.description: AWS Secret key (optional, uncommented if set)

s3_access_key.description: AWS Access key (optional, uncommented if set)

s3_token.description: AWS Short lived token (optional, uncommented if set)

gcloud_json_auth_file.description: Google JSON auth file path (optional, uncommented if set)

gcloud_json_auth_string.description: Google JSON auth content as string (optional, uncommented if set)
